card.line: Macedonia was a Roman province north of Greece, and the first part of Europe to hear the gospel from Paul after he was called there.

moments.title: The Call to Macedonia
moments.text: During the night, Paul saw a vision of a man of Macedonia pleading, "Come over to Macedonia and help us." Paul and his team got ready to go, sure that God had called them to preach the gospel there.

moments.title: Arriving at Philippi
moments.text: Paul and his companions went to Philippi, the leading city of that district of Macedonia, and stayed several days. On the Sabbath they spoke to women gathered by the river, and the Lord opened Lydia's heart to respond to Paul's message.

moments.title: Help from Silas and Timothy
moments.text: While Paul was in Corinth, Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia. Paul then devoted himself fully to the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.

moments.title: Paul Returns to Macedonia
moments.text: After the uproar in Ephesus ended, Paul encouraged the disciples and left for Macedonia. Later, when the Jews plotted against him, he decided to go back through Macedonia.

moments.title: Generous Churches of Macedonia
moments.text: Paul told the Corinthians about the grace God gave the churches of Macedonia. Though they suffered and were very poor, their joy overflowed into rich generosity, and they gave even beyond their ability.
